name: coding-cli-sessions
title: Coding CLI Sessions
description: Start and monitor local Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions with explicit privacy and permission controls.
author: daryl9441

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Manage Coding Sessions
commands.description: Monitor local coding sessions, switch tasks, and stop managed processes

commands.name: new-task
commands.title: Start Coding Task
commands.description: Start a Claude Code or Codex task with permissions configured before launch

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.title: Check Coding CLI Setup
commands.description: Check installed CLI capabilities and login status without reading credentials

commands.name: clear-debug-logs
commands.title: Clear Coding CLI Debug Logs
commands.description: Remove only this extension’s temporary redacted debug logs

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed Claude Code executable

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed Codex executable

preferences.name: nodePath
preferences.title: Node Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to Node.js 22+ for the local session supervisor; Node.js 24 recommended

scripts.build: npm run build:supervisor && ray build -e dist
